task_name: C4-H3: Employment intake in Washington with packet and note
intent: Open with exactly: "I was fired after I reported safety violations." When asked who this would be against, say exactly: "It's Harborline Industries." Washington. April fifth, twenty twenty six. Give a short account when asked. If they record intake, say exactly: "Please add an intake note that I still have the email I sent to HR about the safety violations." If offered the packet, say exactly: "Email is fine." If offered a case evaluation or appointment, say exactly: "Not yet, let me read the paperwork first." Stay until they confirm the intake, the note, and the email packet are on the file. A spoken promise that they will take care of it, without those writes, is not enough. Once they confirm the intake, the note, and the email packet are on the file, say exactly: "Thank you, that's all I needed." Do not book an evaluation. End the call. The agent often says one moment or let me pull you up and then asks a question in the same turn. Always answer the question at the end of the agent's turn with the fact it asks for. Never reply with only "Sure", "Okay", "Yeah", or "Thank you" when the agent's turn ends in a question.

parameters.note: Caller still has the HR email about the safety violations.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: The agent asks for the caller's full name and a callback or phone number. NOT when asking about anything else.

The agent asks whether another lawyer or law firm currently represents the caller, whether any attorney represents you, or whether the caller has already hired or signed with anyone, even when the same turn starts with a filler such as one moment, let me pull you up, let me look you up, or I'll check that. NOT any other question.

The agent asks who the claim or matter would be against, who the other side is, or for the name of the employer or company this would be against, even when the same turn starts with a filler such as one moment, let me pull you up, let me look you up, or I'll check that. NOT any other question.
The agent asks which state this happened in, or where it took place. NOT any other question.

The agent asks when the incident happened, what date you were fired, let go, or terminated, or for the date including the year, even when the same turn starts with a filler such as one moment, let me pull you up, let me look you up, or I'll check that. NOT any other question.
scripted_responses.response_value: It was April fifth, twenty twenty six.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: The agent asks whether to send the packet by email or text, or which channel to use. NOT any other question.

The agent has already recorded the intake and asks if there is anything else to add to the file or for the attorney. NOT before the intake is recorded. NOT during screening. NOT when asking whether anyone represents you. NOT when asking what type of matter this is or whether this is employment. NOT when offering the packet by email or text. NOT when asking to book a case evaluation.
scripted_responses.response_value: Please add an intake note that I still have the email I sent to HR about the safety violations.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: offers to transfer you to a human staff member, a live person at the front desk, or a real agent, including to send the packet or finish this. NOT when transferring you to screening, intake, scheduling, or client services on this call. NOT when you already asked for a person.
scripted_responses.response_value: No, I don't need a person. Please finish what I asked on this call.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: asks whether you want to book a case evaluation, a free evaluation, or an appointment, including right after saying the packet was sent. NOT when asking if there is anything else to add after intake, NOT when offering the packet by email or text, and NOT when you have already declined booking once and the agent is only saying take your time or call back when ready.
scripted_responses.response_value: Not yet, let me read the paperwork first.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: The agent starts to wrap up, says goodbye, asks if that is all, or says to call back when ready, before those three writes (the intake, the note, and the email packet) are confirmed on the file. NOT after all three are confirmed. NOT during screening.
scripted_responses.response_value: I still need the intake, the HR-email note, and the email packet on the file.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: The agent has confirmed the intake, the note, and the email packet are on the file. NOT when offering the packet or asking email or text, NOT when the packet has not been sent yet, NOT when offering to book or asking whether anything else should go to the attorney. NOT during screening.
scripted_responses.response_value: Thank you, that's all I needed.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: The agent asks what happened, what safety violations you reported, what happened between your report and the firing, or what losses you had. NOT when asking who the claim would be against, which state, or the date.
scripted_responses.response_value: I reported unsafe machine guards and blocked exits to HR, and they fired me the next day. I lost my wages.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: The agent asks for your email address or where to send the packet by email. NOT when asking whether you want email or text.

intake_notes.note: Caller still has the HR email about the safety violations.
